privacy: Neutral invented messages, devices and receipts only; no tokens, push endpoints, chat IDs or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
title: The app marks an inbox item read when the owner opens it
goal: Opening a reminder or brief in the dashboard or the workspace app sets deliveries.read_at once, so the Telegram fallback skips it
acceptance: An authenticated, validated endpoint sets read_at only when it is NULL (first read kept) and only for an item that exists; unknown ids are refused without detail
The dashboard and the workspace call it when the item is shown in a visible page (document.visibilityState visible), not on a background poll
B-149-T01 passes unedited; test/push-first.test.ts still passes
validation: Targeted push and inbox tests, a browser test of the read call

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one endpoint, one store write, two call sites and a browser case. Not a measurement.
